rules.name: Cultural Attaché
rules.intro: Spend 1 Hope and make a Presence check against a target's Presence or Instinct (defender chooses the higher). On a success, ask the Keeper one question about the target's true intentions, fears, or loyalties, which they must answer honestly.

foundation.name: The Unmasking Gaze
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Hope and make a Presence check against a target's Presence or Instinct (defender chooses the higher). On a success, ask the Keeper one question about the target's true intentions, fears, or loyalties, which they must answer honestly.

specialization.name: Social Chameleon
specialization.desc: You blend in anywhere. In a new social environment, spend 1 Hope to declare a plausible identity and contacts there; gain Advantage on your first social roll in that scene.

mastery.name: Universal Argument
mastery.desc: Once per session, spend 3 Hope to make a statement so compelling it transcends language. One target who can perceive you must comply with a single, reasonable command, regardless of whether they understand your words.

sleepingRules.name: Cultural Attaché
sleepingRules.intro: You speak fluently any galactic language that has at least 100 living speakers. For dead languages or extremely rare tongues, you have working competence with a Knowledge roll at advantage.

foundation.name: Mother Tongue (Passive).
foundation.desc: You speak fluently any galactic language that has at least 100 living speakers. For dead languages or extremely rare tongues, you have working competence with a Knowledge roll at advantage.

specialization.name: The Listening Posture (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. For the next minute of conversation, you understand not only what the NPC is saying but what they mean to say but cannot. The Keeper provides a brief paraphrase of the subtext after each significant statement.

mastery.name: The Reconciliation (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, mediate between two conflicting parties willing to sit. Roll Presence; the DC scales with the depth of the grievance. On success they agree terms; influence scales with the roll. A critical buries the grievance itself.

rules.name: Political Operative
rules.intro: You start each session with 2 Favor Tokens. You can spend a Favor to introduce a helpful NPC contact or to produce a piece of common (Tier 1) gear as a "gift" from a contact.

foundation.name: Web of Favors
foundation.desc: You start each session with 2 Favor Tokens. You can spend a Favor to introduce a helpful NPC contact or to produce a piece of common (Tier 1) gear as a "gift" from a contact.

specialization.name: Call in a Debt
specialization.desc: Spend 2 Favor Tokens to compel an NPC to perform a significant and risky service. They cannot refuse without serious consequences (loss of status, wealth, or physical harm). Your maximum Favor Tokens increases to 5.

mastery.name: Checkmate
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, you can spend 5 Favor Tokens to orchestrate a major political event, expose a rival's secret, trigger a vote of no confidence, start a scandal, instigate a coup. Describe the outcome you want, and the Keeper describes the repercussions. 43

sleepingRules.name: Political Operative
sleepingRules.intro: At the start of any new political environment (a city, a station, a fleet), you may spend a Short Rest mapping the informal power structure. The Keeper provides three significant relationships, debts, or grievances that are not common knowledge.

foundation.name: The Quiet Map (Passive).
foundation.desc: At the start of any new political environment (a city, a station, a fleet), you may spend a Short Rest mapping the informal power structure. The Keeper provides three significant relationships, debts, or grievances that are not common knowledge.

specialization.name: Lever (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. You apply a piece of known leverage to an NPC during a social scene. The Keeper describes the NPC's resistance and what concessions, if any, are now possible. Successful application of leverage may also incur a permanent enmity, leverage is remembered.

mastery.name: The Dossier (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, you produce a sealed dossier on a named NPC. Its contents, if released, would destroy that NPC's position. You may threaten its release; you may release it; you may, most dangerously of all, use its existence as a private gift. The Keeper helps you determine the dossier's exact contents only at the moment of use.

rules.name: The Icon
rules.intro: Make a Presence check (DC 15) to perform or report; on success, gain 1 Favor Token.

foundation.name: Control the Narrative
foundation.desc: Make a Presence check (DC 15) to perform or report; on success, gain 1 Favor Token.

specialization.name: The Story's Debt
specialization.desc: Spend 2 Favors to declare that a target NPC now owes you a Favor. Narrate how your past work inspired them. This cannot be refused.

mastery.name: The Address
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, speak to a crowd. Roll Presence; the Keeper sets the DC by the crowd's size and hostility, and influence scales with the roll. On a critical, choose a theme (Hope, Defiance, Peace, Rebellion, Sorrow) and the Keeper describes how the new narrative reshapes the system.

rules.name: Medical Technician
rules.intro: Mark 1 Stress to perform emergency medical aid. You can either heal a target for 2 HP plus 1 HP for 1d4 rounds, *or* stabilize a dying creature, *or* remove a level of Degradation from an augmentation.

foundation.name: Field Surgery
foundation.desc: Mark 1 Stress to perform emergency medical aid. You can either heal a target for 2 HP plus 1 HP for 1d4 rounds, *or* stabilize a dying creature, *or* remove a level of Degradation from an augmentation.

specialization.name: Bio-Mechanic
specialization.desc: You are an expert in the fusion of flesh and steel. All healing you perform on augmented individuals or with technological tools (like a Medkit) heals an additional +1 HP. Additionally, you can craft cybernetic implants as a Long-Term Project.

mastery.name: Miracle Worker
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, you can spend 3 Hope to bring a character who died within the last hour back from the brink of death. They are revived with 1 HP and a new, permanent scar, narrative or mechanical, determined with the Keeper.

sleepingRules.name: Medical Technician
sleepingRules.intro: Spend 1 Effort. You assess the medical state of every conscious or unconscious creature within Close range. The Keeper tells you who is dying, who is stable, and who is faking.

foundation.name: The Triage (Action).
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Effort. You assess the medical state of every conscious or unconscious creature within Close range. The Keeper tells you who is dying, who is stable, and who is faking.

specialization.name: Stabilize (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. A creature that would die at the end of this turn does not die. They remain critically wounded until next encountered, at which point they are stable but still injured.

mastery.name: The Last Rite (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, when a named character has died, you may perform a six-hour procedure that returns them to life with a permanent Scar. The Scar is medically real (a missing limb, a damaged organ, a chronic condition), and it is not removable by future treatment. This is a Sleeping mastery: the body is what is, and what is restored is the body's continuation, not its perfection.

rules.name: Tech Specialist
rules.intro: You have Advantage on all hacking and technology rolls. When you successfully hack a system, you leave no trace of your intrusion unless you choose to.

foundation.name: Digital Ghost
foundation.desc: You have Advantage on all hacking and technology rolls. When you successfully hack a system, you leave no trace of your intrusion unless you choose to.

specialization.name: ICE Breaker
specialization.desc: When you encounter a security system, you can spend 1 Hope to obtain information about any technological system in the area, including weaknesses, access points, and access codes.

mastery.name: Master of the Matrix
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 3 Hope to establish an unhackable and undetectable quantum communications network across a star system. This network allows secure and real-time communications with anyone you know in the system, and cannot be intercepted or tracked.

sleepingRules.name: Tech Specialist
sleepingRules.intro: Spend 1 Effort to audit any networked system you have access to. The Keeper tells you what processes are running, what data has moved in the last hour, and what anomalies, if any, are present.

foundation.name: The Audit (Action).
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Effort to audit any networked system you have access to. The Keeper tells you what processes are running, what data has moved in the last hour, and what anomalies, if any, are present.

specialization.name: The Quiet Hand (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. You modify a system you have audited; the modification persists until discovered. The Keeper describes the realistic parameters of the modification's stealth.

mastery.name: The Dead Drop (Passive).
mastery.desc: You maintain a permanent, hidden access channel into any system you have administered for at least one week. The Keeper tracks these channels; they may be discovered, but they do not expire.

rules.name: Xenotech Savant
rules.intro: You have become an expert in alien technology. You can operate any xenotech without penalties, and you have Advantage when trying to understand or modify its functions.

foundation.name: Adaptive Interface
foundation.desc: You have become an expert in alien technology. You can operate any xenotech without penalties, and you have Advantage when trying to understand or modify its functions.

specialization.name: Xenotech Integration
specialization.desc: You can spend 1 Hope to temporarily integrate a piece of alien technology into your equipment or ship, gaining its benefits for the rest of the scene. This could be enhanced sensors, adaptive armor, or exotic weapons.

mastery.name: Technological Symbiosis
mastery.desc: You have formed a permanent bond with an alien AI or technological entity. Once per session, you can spend 2 Hope to ask your symbiont for critical help. It might provide vital information, take control of nearby systems, or even manifest as a technological construct to assist you.

sleepingRules.name: Xenotech Savant
sleepingRules.intro: When you encounter unfamiliar technology, you may consult your catalog (a large, ugly, hand-written document the character keeps). The Keeper tells you whether your catalog has a relevant entry, and if so, what it says, including its limits.

foundation.name: The Catalog (Passive).
foundation.desc: When you encounter unfamiliar technology, you may consult your catalog (a large, ugly, hand-written document the character keeps). The Keeper tells you whether your catalog has a relevant entry, and if so, what it says, including its limits.

specialization.name: The Procedure (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort to apply a documented procedure to an unfamiliar artifact. The Keeper resolves the interaction more safely than an untested one would resolve. (Your procedures are conservative; this is intentional.)

mastery.name: The New Page (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, after extensive observation, you add an unfamiliar artifact's behavior to your catalog. From that point forward, you and your party have working competence with that class of artifact.

rules.name: Cartographer
rules.intro: You have Advantage on long-distance Piloting and astrogation rolls. You also have Advantage on *Chart a Safe Route* during a Void Crawl.

foundation.name: Cosmic Cartography
foundation.desc: You have Advantage on long-distance Piloting and astrogation rolls. You also have Advantage on *Chart a Safe Route* during a Void Crawl.

specialization.name: Eye for the Anomaly
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Hope when using Scan the Area to gain Advantage on the roll. With Success + Hope, you also gain an extra Intel question.

mastery.name: The Unseen Path
mastery.desc: Once per major session, spend 3 Hope to find a hidden route or method that bypasses an obstacle, a hazard, or a fortified position the rest of the crew thought was impassable.

sleepingRules.name: Cartographer
sleepingRules.intro: You can determine your position on any planet, station, or vessel without instrumentation, with at most a 5% error.

foundation.name: Dead Reckoning (Passive).
foundation.desc: You can determine your position on any planet, station, or vessel without instrumentation, with at most a 5% error.

specialization.name: The Marked Route (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. You leave a permanent, subtle trail along your route. Anyone in your party (or anyone you teach the marks to) can follow this trail without rolling.

mastery.name: The Chart (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, you complete a definitive chart of a region, system, or sector. The chart functions as a faction asset, sold, gifted, or referenced, and earns you standing with the Explorers' Guild and any party that uses it.

rules.name: The Stalker
rules.intro: As an action, mark a single target. Until your next long rest, you have Advantage on Instinct rolls to track them, and your first successful attack each round against the marked quarry deals an extra **1d6 damage**.

foundation.name: Mark Quarry
foundation.desc: As an action, mark a single target. Until your next long rest, you have Advantage on Instinct rolls to track them, and your first successful attack each round against the marked quarry deals an extra **1d6 damage**.

specialization.name: Unrelenting Pursuit
specialization.desc: While pursuing your marked quarry, spend 1 Hope to flawlessly overcome one environmental obstacle without losing time or momentum.

mastery.name: The Trap is Sprung
mastery.desc: Once per session, spend 3 Hope to declare you have set a trap for your marked quarry in the current location. Describe the trap; your quarry is automatically Restrained or Cornered for the scene. 47

sleepingRules.name: The Stalker
sleepingRules.intro: Mark a target. For the next 24 hours, you have advantage on Instinct rolls to track them and your first successful attack each round against them deals an extra 1d6 damage.

foundation.name: Mark Quarry (Action).
foundation.desc: Mark a target. For the next 24 hours, you have advantage on Instinct rolls to track them and your first successful attack each round against them deals an extra 1d6 damage.

specialization.name: Unrelenting Pursuit (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. While pursuing your marked quarry, you cross one significant environmental obstacle without losing time or momentum.

mastery.name: The Trap is Sprung (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per session, spend 3 Effort to declare you set a trap for your marked quarry in the current location. The trap's nature is yours to describe; the quarry, on entering, is Restrained or Cornered for the scene.

rules.name: Wilderness
rules.intro: Gain Advantage on Knowledge rolls to identify flora and fauna, and on Instinct rolls to track creatures or find natural resources.

foundation.name: Naturalist's Eye
foundation.desc: Gain Advantage on Knowledge rolls to identify flora and fauna, and on Instinct rolls to track creatures or find natural resources.

specialization.name: Environmental Symbiosis
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Hope. For the scene, you need no food or water, you have Advantage on Survival rolls against natural hazards, and you may temporarily gain a minor beneficial trait from a local creature (Keeper's discretion).

mastery.name: Primal Connection
mastery.desc: Spend 3 Hope (once per session) to command local non-sentient fauna up to a Major threat for one scene. Alternatively, spend 1 Hope to instantly find a safe shelter or a vital natural resource in your current environment.

sleepingRules.name: Wilderness
sleepingRules.intro: You and one ally never suffer the Hungry, Thirsty, or Exhausted conditions in any environment that supports Class-IV humanoid life.

foundation.name: Self-Reliant (Passive).
foundation.desc: You and one ally never suffer the Hungry, Thirsty, or Exhausted conditions in any environment that supports Class-IV humanoid life.

specialization.name: The Old Craft (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort, choose one. We Camp Here: declare a defensible camp in hostile terrain; during a rest here the environment cannot reach you, one watch suffices, and the party clears 2 additional Stress. The Weather Turns: read sky, current, or pressure; declare what the environment will do in the coming hours, and it does. Live Off This: in any living environment, produce the food, water, or remedy the scene needs.

mastery.name: The Old Way (Passive).
mastery.desc: You and any allies under your guidance can travel through hostile environments at full pace and without injury. The Keeper still adjudicates encounters, but the environment itself does not harm you.

rules.name: Mind-Touched
rules.intro: Spend 1 Hope to allow an ally to use your Presence or Instinct modifier for one roll. Once per rest, you can spend 1 Stress to grant your entire crew a mental shield, giving them Advantage on rolls to resist fear or psychic influence for one scene.

foundation.name: Thought Tide
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Hope to allow an ally to use your Presence or Instinct modifier for one roll. Once per rest, you can spend 1 Stress to grant your entire crew a mental shield, giving them Advantage on rolls to resist fear or psychic influence for one scene.

specialization.name: Implant Suggestion
specialization.desc: Make a Presence vs. Presence or Instinct (defender chooses the higher) contest. On a success, you plant a single, subtle command in a target's mind (e.g., forget my face, trust me, drop your weapon). The target believes the thought is their own.

mastery.name: Collective Consciousness
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 3 Hope to merge your mind with up to 3 allies in Close range for one scene. You share senses, emotions, and thoughts, gaining Advantage on all group rolls and on Instinct rolls to detect dangers.

foundation.name: Perfect Invocation
foundation.desc: Once per Short Rest, manifest one known Power at or below your level with no Resolve, access roll, or Spellcast Roll. Keeper gains 1 Fear. Retain non-Hope costs and restrictions.

specialization.name: Reach Beyond
specialization.desc: Once per session, attempt an unknown Power exactly one level above you from a Domain you have studied. Keeper gains 1 Fear; roll Knowledge against DC 10 + level. The Power is not learned.

mastery.name: Impossible Efficiency
mastery.desc: Once per session, each Resolve spent on Uncanny Power contributes two Effort Dice instead of one; Fear is based on Resolve actually spent.

rules.name: Precursor Touched
rules.intro: Spend 1 Hope to open your mind to a Precursor artifact or site. The Keeper will give you a cryptic, dream-like vision related to its purpose or history. You gain Advantage on all rolls to interact with it for the scene.

foundation.name: Ancient Echo
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Hope to open your mind to a Precursor artifact or site. The Keeper will give you a cryptic, dream-like vision related to its purpose or history. You gain Advantage on all rolls to interact with it for the scene.

specialization.name: Waken the Sleepers
specialization.desc: Mark 1 Stress. You can temporarily awaken a dormant Precursor device. The device will perform its most basic function for one minute. The results are often unpredictable and dangerous.

mastery.name: Cosmic Truth
mastery.desc: Spend 3 Stress to ask one specific, actionable question about the current story arc. The answer is true, but the Keeper gains 2 Fear and introduces a complication.

foundation.name: Persistent Inquiry
foundation.desc: Advance one Domain Study Project by 1 segment during every Long Rest without consuming a Long Rest move.

specialization.name: Pattern Recognition
specialization.desc: Reduce a new Domain Study clock by the Spellcast Trait modifier, minimum 2 segments.

mastery.name: Parallel Reconstruction
mastery.desc: Research two Domain Paths simultaneously and apply each progress gain to both. Parallel projects do not receive Pattern Recognition's clock reduction.

rules.name: Veil Walker
rules.intro: When you are the target of an attack or need to move through an obstacle, you can spend 1 Stress to "blink" to a location in Close range, evading the attack or obstacle. Once per short rest, you can create a pocket dimensional sanctuary that lasts 10 minutes, invisible and inaccessible.

foundation.name: Phase Step
foundation.desc: When you are the target of an attack or need to move through an obstacle, you can spend 1 Stress to "blink" to a location in Close range, evading the attack or obstacle. Once per short rest, you can create a pocket dimensional sanctuary that lasts 10 minutes, invisible and inaccessible.

specialization.name: Temporal Distortion
specialization.desc: Once per scene, you can spend 1 Hope to briefly manipulate time around an enemy. That enemy must reroll all dice on their next action and choose the lowest result.

mastery.name: Causality Reverse
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 3 Stress to undo a single, recent event that occurred within Close range. A fatal blow is undone, a destroyed artifact is made whole, a triggered trap is reset. The narrative rewinds.

foundation.name: Layered Working
foundation.desc: Choose two different Calibrated Minor Ritual effects instead of one; every target receives both.

specialization.name: Enduring Formula
specialization.desc: Double ritual duration and unlock Protective Geometry: +1 Evasion or +1 to all damage thresholds for the whole group.

mastery.name: Shared Lattice
mastery.desc: Double numerical ritual benefits; Group Adaptation protects against two hazards; all affected creatures gain group telepathy for the duration.

rules.name: Combat Ace
rules.intro: When you or your ship is the target of an attack, you can spend 1 Stress to add your Agility modifier to the ship's Evasion for that attack.

foundation.name: Tactical Grace
foundation.desc: When you or your ship is the target of an attack, you can spend 1 Stress to add your Agility modifier to the ship's Evasion for that attack.

specialization.name: Target Lock
specialization.desc: Mark 1 Stress to analyze the weaknesses of an enemy or enemy ship. For the rest of the scene, all attacks made by you or your allies against that ship gain +1d4 damage.

mastery.name: Ace Maneuver
mastery.desc: Once per scene, you can spend 2

sleepingRules.name: Combat Ace
sleepingRules.intro: When flying with at least one ally vessel, both vessels gain +1 to maneuver rolls.

foundation.name: Wingman (Passive).
foundation.desc: When flying with at least one ally vessel, both vessels gain +1 to maneuver rolls.

specialization.name: The Tight Turn (Reaction).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. When a hostile vessel locks weapons on you, you execute a turn the lock cannot follow. The lock breaks; the hostile vessel marks 1 Heat.

mastery.name: The Ace's Mark (Passive).
mastery.desc: You may claim, by named record, every kill you have made. The Sleeping Ace does not kill anonymously, the bodies are accounted for. You gain a fearsome reputation. NPC Pilots react to you accordingly; some flee, some seek you out.

rules.name: System Jockey
rules.intro: When attempting to dock, land, or navigate in tight spaces, you can spend 1 Stress to automatically succeed. You can also spend 1 Hope to obtain a complete and detailed map of all defenses and active security systems in the area.

foundation.name: Orbital Whisperer
foundation.desc: When attempting to dock, land, or navigate in tight spaces, you can spend 1 Stress to automatically succeed. You can also spend 1 Hope to obtain a complete and detailed map of all defenses and active security systems in the area.

specialization.name: Gravity Slingshot
specialization.desc: When performing a gravity assist maneuver, you can make a Finesse + Piloting roll (DC 12). On success, you reach your destination in half the time and consume no fuel for the maneuver. On failure, you reach the correct destination but the journey is rough, causing 1 Stress to all crew members.

mastery.name: Ghost in the Machine
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 3 Hope to seamlessly integrate into the systems of a station or capital ship during a scene.

sleepingRules.name: System Jockey
sleepingRules.intro: Spend 1 Effort during starship combat. A damaged ship system goes from failed to limited functionality for the rest of the encounter.

foundation.name: The Quick Repair (Action).
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Effort during starship combat. A damaged ship system goes from failed to limited functionality for the rest of the encounter.

specialization.name: The Modified Loadout
specialization.desc: (Passive). Your ship has one custom modification, declared at character creation, that no other ship has. The Keeper helps you decide what it is, and it is mechanically modest but narratively significant.

mastery.name: The Total Refit (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, after extensive downtime, you and your ship undergo a refit that grants permanent advancement: a new system, a doubled capacity, a hidden compartment. The refit is recorded as part of your ship's character.

rules.name: Void Runner
rules.intro: Mark 1 Stress to sense the safest or fastest route through a dangerous area (asteroid field, nebula, contested system). You and your ship gain Advantage on all Piloting and Evasion rolls while following this route during the scene.

foundation.name: Pathfinder's Sense
foundation.desc: Mark 1 Stress to sense the safest or fastest route through a dangerous area (asteroid field, nebula, contested system). You and your ship gain Advantage on all Piloting and Evasion rolls while following this route during the scene.

specialization.name: Sensor Savant
specialization.desc: When you make a sensor or navigation roll, you can spend 1 Hope to gain Advantage. If you succeed with Hope, you also discover a hidden detail, a cloaked ship, a secret passage, a valuable resource.

mastery.name: Veil Dancer
mastery.desc: You have become one with the Veil currents. You no longer suffer penalties for navigating through Veil storms.

sleepingRules.name: Void Runner
sleepingRules.intro: You know one route, in any reasonably familiar region, that the patrols do not watch. The route is real and useful for the duration of the campaign or until the Keeper introduces a complication.

foundation.name: The Quiet Lane (Passive).
foundation.desc: You know one route, in any reasonably familiar region, that the patrols do not watch. The route is real and useful for the duration of the campaign or until the Keeper introduces a complication.

specialization.name: The Cold Run (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Your ship is, for the next hour, untraceable to standard scanning. (Specialized scanning still finds you; assume sensor parity with hostile capability.)

mastery.name: The Untouched Record (Passive).
mastery.desc: Your name does not appear in any standard Imperial or House record as a known smuggler. (The PEOPLE who know what you do, know. The systems do not.)

rules.name: Information Theorist
rules.intro: When you fail a decryption or hacking roll, you can spend 1 Stress to reroll the dice. If you succeed, you can also create a temporary firewall that protects that system for one scene.

foundation.name: Data Storm
foundation.desc: When you fail a decryption or hacking roll, you can spend 1 Stress to reroll the dice. If you succeed, you can also create a temporary firewall that protects that system for one scene.

specialization.name: Social Algorithm
specialization.desc: You have Advantage on all social rolls against any organization you have previously analyzed. You can spend 1 Stress to predict an organization's next move, gaining a key clue.

mastery.name: Quantum Network
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 3 Hope to establish an instant and undetectable quantum communications network across a star system for the duration of the scene. 53

sleepingRules.name: Information Theorist
sleepingRules.intro: When presented with any document, recording, or testimony, you may, after one minute of inspection, ask the Keeper one question about its provenance: who made it, when, under what conditions, and with what likely biases.

foundation.name: The Source Critique (Passive).
foundation.desc: When presented with any document, recording, or testimony, you may, after one minute of inspection, ask the Keeper one question about its provenance: who made it, when, under what conditions, and with what likely biases.

specialization.name: The Model (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort modeling a system: a market, a patrol, a network, a crowd. Declare its behavior for the next hour absent intervention, and the Keeper adopts it; or inject one false datum the system treats as legitimate until audited.

mastery.name: The Settled Question (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, declare a contested historical question settled by your work. The settlement reverberates in the academic community; future scenes acknowledge the consensus you produced.

rules.name: Precursor Archaeologist
rules.intro: Spend 1 Hope to attune to a Precursor artifact. The Keeper will reveal a fragment of its history or a clue about how to use it. You have Advantage on all rolls to activate Precursor technology for the scene.

foundation.name: Artifact Whisper
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Hope to attune to a Precursor artifact. The Keeper will reveal a fragment of its history or a clue about how to use it. You have Advantage on all rolls to activate Precursor technology for the scene.

specialization.name: Cultural Reconstructor
specialization.desc: When interacting with a faction you have studied, you gain +2 to all social rolls. Additionally, you can spend 1 Stress to recall a key custom or taboo, avoiding a serious social mistake.

mastery.name: Philosophy Engine
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 3 Hope to decipher a fundamental principle of pre-Silence wisdom. This allows you to create a single-use, relic-tier invention that can drastically alter a situation, a device that nullifies local gravity, a translator that works on any speech, a scanner that briefly …

sleepingRules.name: Precursor Archaeologist
sleepingRules.intro: You can date Precursor structures by visual inspection alone, with at most a 200-year error.

foundation.name: The Stratigraphic Eye (Passive).
foundation.desc: You can date Precursor structures by visual inspection alone, with at most a 200-year error.

specialization.name: As Built (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort studying a Precursor structure. The Keeper describes what it was built to do and how it worked; if it has a deactivation mechanism, you now know where it is. Reaching it is your problem.

mastery.name: The Site Report (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, you complete a definitive site report. The site is, from this point forward, understood; it does not stop being dangerous, but its history is no longer mysterious. Future scenes there resolve faster.

rules.name: Xenobiologist
rules.intro: Spend 1 Hope to study an organism (living or dead) and learn its biology, behavior, and weaknesses. The Keeper will reveal a mechanical weakness (e.g., Vulnerable to an energy type) or a narrative weakness (e.g., afraid of light).

foundation.name: Life Reader
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Hope to study an organism (living or dead) and learn its biology, behavior, and weaknesses. The Keeper will reveal a mechanical weakness (e.g., Vulnerable to an energy type) or a narrative weakness (e.g., afraid of light).

specialization.name: Ecosystem Decoder
specialization.desc: You have Advantage on all Survival and navigation rolls in alien biomes. Additionally, you can spend 1 Stress to identify a native plant or animal that can be used as a resource, poison, medicine, food.

mastery.name: Evolutionary Forecast
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 3 Hope to predict a significant environmental change in a star system (a solar storm, massive creature migration, disease outbreak). The Keeper will give you vital information about this event, allowing you to prepare for or exploit it.

sleepingRules.name: Xenobiologist
sleepingRules.intro: You have working classification competence with any biological organism you study for at least one minute. The Keeper provides phylum, hazard class, and one notable behavioral trait.

foundation.name: The Catalog of Life (Passive).
foundation.desc: You have working classification competence with any biological organism you study for at least one minute. The Keeper provides phylum, hazard class, and one notable behavioral trait.

specialization.name: The Synthesis (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort with a sample or a minute of study of an organism: neutralize its toxin or spores for the crew this scene, or produce a lure that draws it where you choose, once.

mastery.name: The New Species (Passive).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, you formally describe a new species. The description is published; future scenes acknowledge your authority on it; the Guild credits you. (This is the academic equivalent of slaying a dragon.)

rules.name: Assassin
rules.intro: Spend 1 Stress to create a flawless disguise and identity for one scene. You can spend 1 Hope to make this identity stand up to any level of scrutiny for 24 hours.

foundation.name: Deadly Masquerade
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Stress to create a flawless disguise and identity for one scene. You can spend 1 Hope to make this identity stand up to any level of scrutiny for 24 hours.

specialization.name: Viper's Kiss
specialization.desc: When you score a Critical Success on an attack, the target is automatically Stunned. You can also choose to spend 1 Stress to apply a potent neurotoxin (Poisoned effect) to any successful attack.

mastery.name: Perfect Kill
mastery.desc: Once per combat, you can spend 2 Hope to declare your next attack against a target who is unaware of you, Surprised, or Helpless is a perfect kill. It is an automatic Critical Success and deals maximum damage.

sleepingRules.name: Assassin
sleepingRules.intro: You can move silently in any environment that has reasonable cover. NPCs at standard alert do not notice your approach.

foundation.name: The Quiet Approach (Passive).
foundation.desc: You can move silently in any environment that has reasonable cover. NPCs at standard alert do not notice your approach.

specialization.name: The Killing Stroke (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Your first attack of an encounter, against a target unaware of your presence, deals an additional 2d6 damage and ignores the first point of armor.

mastery.name: The Standing Contract (Passive).
mastery.desc: You hold a permanent contract that no living organization currently knows you hold. Its target is a specific named individual. The contract pays out, in full, on the day they die, by your hand or by another's, the contract does not specify. You may decide, at any point, to reveal your role.

rules.name: Contrabandist
rules.intro: Spend 1 Stress to declare you have a small, useful, or contraband item secreted on your person or ship that you have not previously mentioned. The Keeper has final say on what is plausible. Once per session, you can spend 1 Hope to upgrade this declaration to a Tier 1 piece of gear or a small quantity of valuable contraband.

foundation.name: Hidden Cargo
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Stress to declare you have a small, useful, or contraband item secreted on your person or ship that you have not previously mentioned. The Keeper has final say on what is plausible. Once per session, you can spend 1 Hope to upgrade this declaration to a Tier 1 piece of gear or a small quantity of valuable contraband.

specialization.name: Dock Authority
specialization.desc: You have Advantage on all social rolls with port officials, dockmasters, customs agents, and the working staff of stations and waystations. You can spend 1 Hope to ensure that a routine inspection of your ship turns up nothing of interest, regardless of what you are actually carrying.

mastery.name: The Long Con
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, you can spend 3 Hope to declare that an elaborate scheme you set up months or years ago has just paid off.

sleepingRules.name: Contrabandist
sleepingRules.intro: (Passive). Your kit, your ship, your room, wherever you live, has at least one compartment standard searches will miss.

foundation.name: The Hidden Compartment
foundation.desc: (Passive). Your kit, your ship, your room, wherever you live, has at least one compartment standard searches will miss.

specialization.name: The Established Route (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. You move a piece of contraband through a checkpoint or border without being challenged. The route, once used, is logged by the relevant authority but may be reused with diminishing safety.

mastery.name: The Old Captain's Favor (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, call in a major favor from a senior Free Fleet, smuggler-cartel, or House-blacklist contact. The favor is significant, a ship, a passage, a name removed from a list, and is, after this use, repaid forever.

rules.name: Ghost
rules.intro: Mark 1 Stress to become invisible for one round, or to remove all traces of your passage through an area. If you succeed with Hope on a Stealth roll while invisible, you remain invisible.

foundation.name: Ghost
foundation.desc: Mark 1 Stress to become invisible for one round, or to remove all traces of your passage through an area. If you succeed with Hope on a Stealth roll while invisible, you remain invisible.

specialization.name: Like a Whisper
specialization.desc: You are a ghost to machines. You cannot be detected by non-psionic sensors, cameras, or automated systems unless you choose to be.

mastery.name: Shadow Network
mastery.desc: Once per session, you can spend 2 Hope to call upon your network of spies and informants. You can either gain a key piece of information about any target in the sector, or have your network create a diversion or provide a safehouse.

sleepingRules.name: Ghost
sleepingRules.intro: You do not appear on any standard surveillance system. Specialized surveillance with proper procedure can find you; default systems cannot.

foundation.name: Off the Record (Passive).
foundation.desc: You do not appear on any standard surveillance system. Specialized surveillance with proper procedure can find you; default systems cannot.

specialization.name: The Vanishing (Reaction).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. When you would be detected, captured, or photographed, you instead are not. The Keeper resolves how, narratively. Once per scene.

mastery.name: The Erased Record (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, declare that an existing piece of evidence about your activities, a security recording, a witness statement, a written note, has been erased. The Keeper helps you decide how it was done; it is now gone.

rules.name: Guardian
rules.intro: When an ally within Close range is hit by an attack, you can spend 1 Stress to intercept it, taking the damage yourself. When you do, you gain Advantage on your next Melee attack against that attacker.

foundation.name: Bodyguard Protocol
foundation.desc: When an ally within Close range is hit by an attack, you can spend 1 Stress to intercept it, taking the damage yourself. When you do, you gain Advantage on your next Melee attack against that attacker.

specialization.name: Hold the Line!
specialization.desc: Mark 1 Stress. You become a point of mobile cover. Allies adjacent to you gain the benefit of cover (+2 to their Evasion) and can ignore the effects of Stagger or forced movement until your next turn.

mastery.name: Unbreakable
mastery.desc: Once per session, when one or more allies would take damage, you can spend 3 Hope to negate all of it. Describe how you absorb or deflect the assault. For the rest of the scene, your armor's Minor and Major thresholds are reduced by 2.

sleepingRules.name: Guardian
sleepingRules.intro: When an ally within Close range would take damage, you may step into the path. Take half the damage yourself; the ally takes none.

foundation.name: Bodyguard (Reaction).
foundation.desc: When an ally within Close range would take damage, you may step into the path. Take half the damage yourself; the ally takes none.

specialization.name: Hold Position (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Designate a position (a doorway, a corridor, a wounded ally). Until you choose otherwise or you fall, no enemy may pass that position without succeeding on a Strength contest against you.

mastery.name: The Wall (Passive).
mastery.desc: Allies who fight within Close range of you have Advantage on resistance rolls and clear 1 Stress per scene. Your presence steadies people; this is observable training, not a cosmic effect.

rules.name: Military Officer
rules.intro: Mark 1 Stress to grant an ally one of the following benefits on their next action: gain Advantage, their attack ignores cover, or their action does not draw the spotlight.

foundation.name: Call the Shot
foundation.desc: Mark 1 Stress to grant an ally one of the following benefits on their next action: gain Advantage, their attack ignores cover, or their action does not draw the spotlight.

specialization.name: Exploit Weakness
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Hope to analyze an enemy's tactics or equipment. For the rest of the scene, all attacks made by your allies against that enemy have the Armor Piercing quality.

mastery.name: Battlefield Symphony
mastery.desc: Once per session, spend 3 Hope. You perfectly orchestrate the flow of battle. Every other member of the crew may immediately perform one free action.

sleepingRules.name: Military Officer
sleepingRules.intro: Once per scene, allies within Close range each clear 1 Stress. You give an order; they remember why they are here.

foundation.name: Rally (Action).
foundation.desc: Once per scene, allies within Close range each clear 1 Stress. You give an order; they remember why they are here.

specialization.name: Coordinated Strike (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. You and one ally each take an action outside the ally's Spotlight. Both actions gain Advantage if they target the same enemy.

mastery.name: One Way Out (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, your voice organizes a group of non-combatant NPCs into coordinated action: an evacuation, a mutiny, a work stoppage. They move as one while your voice holds.

rules.name: Peacekeeper
rules.intro: Spend 1 Hope to halt a conflict for a single, tense moment. No one can take hostile action until you speak or act. This gives you a key window to negotiate, intimidate, or create an escape route.

foundation.name: Unspoken Authority
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Hope to halt a conflict for a single, tense moment. No one can take hostile action until you speak or act. This gives you a key window to negotiate, intimidate, or create an escape route.

specialization.name: Common Ground
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Stress and make a Presence check. On a success, you find a point of leverage or empathy with one enemy. You can turn them into a temporary ally or remove them from the fight as they question their loyalties. If you succeed with Hope, they reveal a key secret about their leader.

mastery.name: Sanctuary
mastery.desc: Once per session, spend 3 Hope to declare a zone around you as neutral ground. For the scene, no one can willingly initiate violence within this zone, enforced by your sheer presence. 57

sleepingRules.name: Peacekeeper
sleepingRules.intro: Display, without using, your weapon and authority. Hostile NPCs not specifically committed to violence retreat or stand down.

foundation.name: Show of Force (Action).
foundation.desc: Display, without using, your weapon and authority. Hostile NPCs not specifically committed to violence retreat or stand down.

specialization.name: The Disarmament (Action).
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort during a tense scene. One armed NPC is convinced, through your demeanor, your reputation, your position, or all three, to lower their weapon for the duration of the scene. The standdown is real; betraying it has reputational cost.

mastery.name: The Cease-Fire (Action).
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, between two willing parties, you broker a cease-fire that the involved factions honor. The cease-fire's terms are negotiable; its existence is binding while you live.

rules.name: Ghost Blade
rules.intro: Spend 1 Stress to gain +3 Evasion against one incoming attack. If the attack misses due to this bonus, you gain Advantage on your next Melee attack against that attacker.

foundation.name: Perfect Deflection
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Stress to gain +3 Evasion against one incoming attack. If the attack misses due to this bonus, you gain Advantage on your next Melee attack against that attacker.

specialization.name: Unseen Movement
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Hope and make a Finesse Trait Check (DC 14). On success, move up to Far Range. The attacker you move away from gains Disadvantage on its next attack roll against you.

mastery.name: Blade Dance
mastery.desc: Mark 1 Stress. Make a single Melee attack roll against up to three enemies within your reach. You make one roll and compare it to each of their Evasion scores.

foundation.name: The Quiet Strike
foundation.desc: Once per scene, when you make a Melee attack while Hidden, the attack ignores 1 Armor Slot.

specialization.name: The Folded Step
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Move to available cover within Close range and become Hidden. This is not phasing; you have rehearsed this movement for years.

mastery.name: The Folded Exit
mastery.desc: Once per scene, after a successful Melee attack, move from Very Close to Close range toward available cover. Until your next Spotlight, attacks against you have Disadvantage.

rules.name: Kinetic Echo
rules.intro: Spend 1 Hope when targeted by an attack. You force the attacker to **reroll the attack roll** (the Keeper must accept the new result).

foundation.name: Precog Dodge
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Hope when targeted by an attack. You force the attacker to **reroll the attack roll** (the Keeper must accept the new result).

specialization.name: Kinetic Reversal
specialization.desc: When subjected to forced movement, spend 1 Stress to negate the movement and instead move up to your speed in any direction.

mastery.name: Echoing Strike
mastery.desc: When you succeed with Hope on a Melee attack, you create a temporal echo. The target is Dazed until the end of their next turn and suffers 1d6 Void damage at the start of their next turn.

foundation.name: Body Memory
foundation.desc: Choose one kind of physical feat you have drilled to mastery, such as a specific climb, throw, or landing. You perform that feat without rolling in routine conditions only: no active opposition, no time pressure, and no real risk. When the feat is contested, rushed, or dangerous, roll normally.

specialization.name: The Channeled Blow
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Your next Melee attack deals an additional 1d8 Kinetic damage. On a success, move the target one range band directly away from you.

mastery.name: The Settled Ground
mastery.desc: Once per scene, after a successful Melee attack, apply Dazed to the target.

rules.name: Pure Conduit
rules.intro: Spend 1 Stress. Choose one: push one object or creature up to Far Range, *or* create a wall of force that provides cover until your next turn, *or* deal 1d6 Kinetic damage to everything in Close Range (no effect on creatures).

foundation.name: Force Projection
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Stress. Choose one: push one object or creature up to Far Range, *or* create a wall of force that provides cover until your next turn, *or* deal 1d6 Kinetic damage to everything in Close Range (no effect on creatures).

specialization.name: Shield of Will
specialization.desc: When an ally in Close range is targeted by a mental or social attack, spend 1 Stress to impose Disadvantage on the roll.

mastery.name: Immovable Fortress
mastery.desc: Spend 2 Hope to create a shimmering dome of kinetic force with a 5 m radius around you for one scene. The dome is immobile and has an Armor Threshold of 6 and 10 HP. It blocks all physical attacks but does not stop energy or psionic effects.

foundation.name: The Cleared Room
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Effort. For the next minute, you and allies within Close range have Advantage on rolls made to resist or clear Frightened, Confused, and Veil-induced deception.

specialization.name: The Held Truth
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort during a social or interrogation scene. NPCs who knowingly lie to you mark 1 Stress. NPCs who tell you a painful truth clear 1 Stress. Your presence does this without your speaking.

mastery.name: The Cleared Path
mastery.desc: While you remain at a location affected by deception, illusion, or Veil-induced confusion, you and allies within Close range have Advantage on rolls made against those effects.
